title: Extra Light Mexican Corn Tres Leches Flan
description: A funky, crunchy, and light Mexican dessert featuring tres leches and corn, inspired by Veracruz cuisine. This flan is made with a bamboo steamer and is designed to be low-calorie friendly.
instructions: Pound the sesame seeds with a mortar and pestle to release their oils.
Mix the corn kernels, coconut sugar, and salt in a bowl until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg yolks, kecap manis, lime juice, and vanilla extract.
In a blender, combine the evaporated milk, heavy cream, and honey. Blend until smooth.
Pour the milk mixture over the corn mixture and stir until well combined.
Add the tortilla crumbs to the mixture and stir until they are evenly distributed.
Pour the mixture into a bamboo steamer lined with parchment paper.
Place the steamer over boiling water and steam for 45 minutes.
Remove the steamer from the heat and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Drizzle the tres leches (a mixture of evaporated milk, heavy cream, and honey) over the flan.
Refrigerate the flan for at least 2 hours before serving.
